topics.definition: Natural Language Processing (NLP) enables computers to understand, interpret and generate human language.
tips: NLP combines AI, ML and linguistics.

topics.definition: Text data consists of words, sentences and documents used for NLP tasks.
An NLP pipeline preprocesses, analyzes and models text data.
Typical tasks include classification, translation, summarization and question answering.
tips: Choose the right model for the task.

topics.definition: A corpus is a collection of text documents used for NLP research and training.
tips: Larger corpora often improve model quality.

topics.definition: A vocabulary is the set of unique tokens known by a model.
tips: Unknown words may be split into subwords.

topics.definition: NLP powers assistants, search engines, translation, summarization and information extraction.
Use quality datasets, preprocess carefully and evaluate with appropriate metrics.
